title: Questionnaire
description: The product-scoping interview the supervisor generates from the user's DESCRIBE brief. Each question is written to init/product/questionnaire/<NN>-<id>.md (one file per question; NN is the 2-digit order, the file body IS the question text the wizard renders). The propose-questionnaire transition writes the whole set in one invocation.

questions.description: The ordered questions. The array order becomes the NN filename prefix (01-, 02-, …), giving a stable presentation order in the wizard.

id.description: Stable lowercase-kebab slug for the question; the filename stem (under its 2-digit order prefix). Full words, no abbreviations (HNS-1). The answer is recorded under the SAME slug in init/product/answers/, so the slug is the question-to-answer join key.

prompt.description: The question text shown to the human verbatim — the entire file body. One focused product-scoping question.
